sql: SELECT d.date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats d WHERE d.route_id = '151' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'HTX-28' GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date ASC
sql_explanation: Retrieves the daily total passengers (y) for route 151 operated by HTX-28, using the date as the time index (ds).
